request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The steward's dashboard counts are now over the sheet and all its descendants.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The steward's dashboard now counts pending, review and overdue claims across the sheet and all its descendants, not just the sheet itself. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

I only changed the front end; the server already had an endpoint that lists a sheet's descendants.

- **`features/dashboard/dashboard.slot.tsx`**: the dashboard works out the counts for each sheet in the tree and adds them up. Two rules follow the existing code:
  - Each sheet uses its own "today" when deciding which claims are overdue.
  - Whether the counts show at all still depends only on the user being a steward on the sheet they loaded.

  The counts stay blank until every sheet in the tree has loaded, so a partial total never shows.
- **`features/consolidated/useDescendants.ts`** (new): I moved the hook that fetches a sheet's descendants out of `consolidated.slot.tsx` so both features can use it. The consolidated panel now imports it, and its behaviour is unchanged.

There are no data or schema changes and no new audit records.
